title: Bihar Library Eligibility Test BLET 2026
vacancyDetails: Library Eligibility Test notification and application update for Bihar candidates.
qualification: Detailed eligibility will be updated in the official BLET notification.
applicationFee: Fee details will be notified by BSEB.
selectionProcess: Online application -> BLET examination -> Result / further process
documentsRequired: Photograph, signature, Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, B.Ed and category or domicile documents where applicable.
howToApply: Apply through the official BSEB portal from 01/10/2026 to 21/10/2026 after the link is activated.
shortDescription: Bihar BSEB Library Eligibility Test BLET 2026 application update.
content:
Bihar School Examination Board has announced the Library Eligibility Test BLET 2026 application schedule.

Online applications are scheduled from 01 October to 21 October 2026. Confirm eligibility and fee details in the official notice before applying.
